eae2_pattern.workbench.tools_help: Processing patterns: on excludes non-consumed tools, which must be preset in the machine; off retains original amounts. Other pattern types use the server recipe.
eae2_pattern.workbench.multiplier_help: Default ×1; repeatedly use ×2 or ÷2, up to ×%s. Only processing inputs consumed and outputs are scaled; reusable inputs stay unchanged.
eae2_pattern.workbench.multiplier_halve_: Halve the current multiplier, down to ×1. Updates preview and encoded amounts.
eae2_pattern.workbench.multiplier_double: Double the current multiplier, up to ×%s. Updates preview and encoded amounts.
eae2_pattern.workbench.wildcard_missing: Install Wildcard Pattern on both client and server.
eae2_pattern.workbench.wildcard_mode_hel: Independent wildcard editor: separate input/output include/exclude rules and actual recipe previews, up to 2048 recipes per item. No legacy mod required.
eae2_pattern.wildcard.name: Machine wildcard · %s · %s recipes
eae2_pattern.wildcard.bound_help: Independent machine pattern · up to 2048 recipes · right-click to edit
eae2_pattern.wildcard.edit_help: Open the workbench from the machine JEI usage page and regenerate to edit.
eae2_pattern.workbench.skip_wildcard_pro: Machine wildcard requires a real processing recipe
eae2_pattern.editor.title: Machine Wildcard Editor
eae2_pattern.editor.rule_help: Input and output rules combine with AND. Exclusions take priority and reject whole recipes; they never delete recipe materials. Empty include means unrestricted. Supports names, @mod, $tag, &ID, #tooltip, |, - and quotes. Whole-side matching may match different terms on different ingredients; every-ingredient mode requires each scoped slot to match. Scope changes search only, not encoded materials.
eae2_pattern.editor.syntax_help: JEI syntax: @mod $tag &ID #tooltip, |, - and quotes. Exclusion rejects the whole recipe.
eae2_pattern.editor.settings_help: Up to 2048 real recipes per item, bound to machine type. Compressed data has bounded decoding; unusually large recipes may split further. Probabilistic inputs use displayed amounts; probabilistic outputs are not guaranteed drops. Multipliers scale consumed inputs and outputs only. Saving creates a new item and leaves the old one unchanged.
eae2_pattern.editor.capacity_help: Up to 2048 recipes; oversized payloads may split earlier. Server verifies the exact blank count before spending any.
eae2_pattern.editor.preparing: Server is validating and preparing patterns…
eae2_pattern.editor.preview_failed: Server could not encode this recipe
eae2_pattern.editor.machine_search: Search machine name or recipe type ID…
eae2_pattern.editor.legacy_help: Unbound or legacy material rules: right-click and select a machine to configure.
eae2_pattern.editor.policy_empty: No valid input or output remains under this policy. Change the encoding settings.
eae2_pattern.editor.blank_help: Blank carrier: right-click, choose a machine, configure rules, then write the held item. No ME network required; encode it before placing in a provider.
eae2_pattern.editor.save_copy_network: Save a network batch (uses AE2 blank patterns)
eae2_pattern.editor.held_saved: Held pattern written; no additional blank was consumed.
eae2_pattern.editor.held_capacity_help: Encode one carrier without an ME network or extra blanks. Stacked blanks need one empty inventory slot. Up to 2048 recipes per carrier; narrow dynamic rules or use fixed batches.
eae2_pattern.editor.held_settings_help: Writing updates the held carrier in place only after server validation. A changed item, slot or data rejects the write. If multiple items are required nothing is overwritten; reduce the selection or save a network batch. Network batch generation consumes AE2 blank patterns from ME storage.
eae2_pattern.editor.blank_recipe: Shapeless crafting: 1 AE2 blank pattern → 1 blank machine wildcard. Also available in the Tools & Utilities creative tab.
eae2_pattern.editor.extract_choose: Select a recipe in Preview first, then return to extract its forms.
eae2_pattern.editor.extract_none: No recognized forms. Click an ingredient to choose its actual tags.
eae2_pattern.editor.dynamic_help: Store machine and rules only. Provider refresh resolves real recipes; reload can include new matches. Unchecked recipes become exclusions. Each dynamic rule expands at most 2048 recipes; narrow the rule or use fixed batches.
eae2_pattern.editor.fixed_help: Store the checked concrete recipes. New recipes require collection again. Full JEI search supported. Form filters ignore non-consumed circuits and tools.
eae2_pattern.editor.dynamic_query_help: Dynamic queries support $tags, &item IDs, @mod IDs, |, -, * and ?. Use fixed mode for translated names or pinyin, tooltips, tabs or colors. GT and vanilla cooking recipes support dynamic resolution; use fixed mode for unknown machines.
eae2_pattern.editor.dynamic_count: Dynamic rule · %s matches when created (resolved again on refresh)
eae2_pattern.editor.rule_budget: Dynamic items store filters, not child patterns. Runtime caches have bounded capacity.
eae2_pattern.editor.extract_applied: Forms extracted; include searches replaced, exclusions retained.
eae2_pattern.editor.reset_help: Craft one wildcard pattern alone in a crafting grid or AE crafting terminal to clear all NBT into one blank carrier. Unmarked blanks stack to 64; tagged carriers stack to 1. Encoding from a blank stack places one result in an empty inventory slot and keeps the remaining blanks in hand.
eae2_pattern.editor.held_saved_inventory: Encoded one carrier into your inventory; remaining blanks stay in hand.
eae2_pattern.editor.pinyin_help: With Just Enough Characters installed, human-readable names, tooltips and machine/material/form choices accept pinyin and initials, e.g. tieding or td. Use forms/materials for dynamic rules, or fixed mode for name searches.
